newsitem.title: FRANCE: France's Aubry seeks "controlled economic restart".
newsitem.headline: France's Aubry seeks "controlled economic restart".

text.p: Martine Aubry, France's newly appointed minister for employment and social solidarity, said she was in favour of "controlled and organised" French economic pickup, newspapers said.
"Today the engine is broken down. There are problems because there is a lack of perspective, lack of confidence and consumption is not in order," Aubry was quoted as saying.
"That's why an economic restart is necessary, a controlled restart because we cannot do just anything, an organised restart," she added.

"We will organise, under the guidance of the Prime Minister, this conference on wages. It's up to him to decide on the date. It is necessary to re-establish confidence and put in place this restart of well selected sectors of public expenditure and by a wage driven pickup of purchasing power," she added.
